alert.$description: Inline status banner — contextual messaging inside a flow (the betslip footer's 'cannot include suspended outcome', 'odds have changed', 'balance too low', 'log in to place your bet'), plus a solid full-bleed global bar. New to the system: nothing else does colored contextual messaging. Two styles: `outline` (a 12% colored tint fill + a colored 1px border + a status icon, message in white) used for every in-slip banner; `solid` (a solid status fill with dark text) used for the app-wide global bar with a title + subtitle. Four roles map to the semantic status colours (warning/negative/positive) plus accent for info. The betslip itself uses `warning` for nearly everything (even 'balance too low' shows the gold triangle in the reference), but Alert carries all four so it's reusable beyond the slip.

gap.$description: 8px between the icon, body and close.

title.$description: 14px bold — optional title line (the global bar's heading, e.g. 'Global Warning'), above the message.

text.$description: Message/title colour on the outline styles — white on the dark tint.

role.$description: Outline-style colours per status: a 12% colored tint fill (bg.*), a colored border (outline.*), a colored status icon (icon.*). Message text stays text.default (white) on all four.

solid.$description: Solid-fill style — the app-wide global bar. Only `warning` is defined this pass: it's the one solid banner in the reference (bright gold fill, dark text/icon). Solid negative/positive/info need per-role 'text on a bright fill' colours (the deferred text.forLabelBg) to pick dark vs white legibly, so they wait — outline covers those roles meanwhile.

text.$description: Dark text on the bright gold fill (surface-0).
